item.tib: brag dmar ri 'dus gnas bdag bsang mchod bdud rtsi sprin dpung
item.coloph: ces pa'i brag dmar ri 'dus kyi bsang mchod 'di ni/ mchog spral kun dga' rin po che sku mched kyi bzhad (bzhed) ngor dang / 'tshams (mtshams) pa rnam dag 'gyur med sogs ri khrod mtshams grwa rnams kyis bskul ngor/ gsang sngags gling pa yab yum kyis (gyis) mthong khrod du bzhugs skabs su/ mthong snang gang shar bzhin rtse drug dben gnas su bris pa dge legs 'phel//
